Map of France

Source: R/fra_sf.R
fra_sf.Rd

A map of France as sf object. Can be used as dataset or for maps

Usage

fra_sf

Format

A data frame with 96 rows, 5 variables and a spatial geometry (MULTIPOLYGON):

OBJECTID

polygon identifier

pays

country: France

region

region name

departement

departement name

id_dpt

departement id

geometry

polygon geometry
